summary: SPAR Group filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to a Services Agreement with ReposiTrak, allowing payment in cash or common stock. ReposiTrak elected stock, receiving 3,190,569 shares at $0.7287 each for $2.325M owed. The issuance was an exempt transaction under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). This is a routine contractual payment settlement, not a special situation. No tender offer, buyback, activism, or strategic change is involved. The filing lacks any event typical of special-situations categories.
